spans.s:
तृतीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Third.
 f. (-या) The third lunation the third day
of the fortnight.
 E. त्रि three, तीय affix, रि changed to the analogous
vowel ऋ.

तृतीयक m. (-कः) A tertian ague.
 E. कन added to the last.

तृतीयकज्वर m. (-रः) Tertian ague.
 E. तृतीय, and ज्वर fever.

तृतीयप्रकृति f. (-तिः)
 1. A eunuch.
 2. The neuter gender: see तृतीयाप्रकृति.

तृतीयाप्रकृति f. (-तिः)
 1. A eunuch.
 2. The neuter gender.
 E. तृतीय the
third, प्रकृति nature; neither male nor female (whose or which) the
compound if more regularly तृतीयप्रकृति.

तृतीयाकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Thrice ploughed, (a field, &c.
 E. तृतीय third,
आकृत made, wrought.

तृतीयिन् mfn. (-यी-यिनी-यि) Having a third.
 E. तृतीय, and इनि aff.
